userStories.title: Fix hardcoded Jill path in ralph.sh auto-pick Python block
userStories.description:
Current state: ralph.sh line 52 has sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/ralph") which breaks on any non-Jill machine.

What to fix: Replace the hardcoded path with a relative path using SCRIPT_DIR.

Code at line 52-60 currently:
  $PYTHON - <<'EOF'
  import sys
  sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/jill/.openclaw/workspace/ralph")
  from prd_manager import list_active_projects
  ...

Fix: use sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) or pass SCRIPT_DIR as env var.

Commit: git add ralph.sh && git commit -m fix: use relative path in ralph.sh auto-pick

userStories.title: Fix sudo governor failure silently eaten in ralph.sh
userStories.description:
Current state: ralph.sh _set_governor() uses '|| true' which silently swallows sudo failures. Most non-root users will get a silent no-op.

What to fix: Add a check — if sudo is not available or fails, log a warning instead of silent '|| true'. Also detect if running as root (skip governor flip entirely).

Commit: git add ralph.sh && git commit -m fix: warn on governor flip failure instead of silent no-op

userStories.title: Fix hardcoded model path in ralph.sh critique mode
userStories.description:
Current state: ralph.sh critique block hardcodes model as 'Qwen_Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf' instead of reading from config.yaml.

What to fix: Read model ID from config.yaml like the rest of the pipeline does. The config is loaded by ralph.py at startup — the critique block should do the same.

Commit: git add ralph.sh && git commit -m fix: read model from config.yaml in critique mode

userStories.title: Add 500 error retry to ralph.py call_model
userStories.description:
Current state: ralph.py retry loop catches requests.Timeout, 429, 503, 502 explicitly but NOT 500 Internal Server Error. A single 500 on a long request fails immediately.

What to fix: Add 500 to the list of retryable HTTP errors in call_model. Keep max retries at 1-2 to avoid infinite loops.

Commit: git add ralph.py && git commit -m fix: retry on HTTP 500 in call_model

userStories.title: Fix story_elapsed always 0 in loop_runner.py
userStories.description:
Current state: loop_runner.py has:
  story_elapsed = sidecar_elapsed if sidecar_elapsed > 0 else time.time() - time.time()
The fallback is always 0 since time.time() - time.time() == 0.

What to fix: Remove the broken sidecar_elapsed branch entirely and always use:
  story_elapsed = time.time() - story_start_time
Track story_start_time at the beginning of the loop iteration.

Commit: git add loop_runner.py && git commit -m fix: always compute story_elapsed correctly

userStories.title: Relax command blocklist: allow rm in known build dirs, pip install with flag
userStories.description:
Current state: tools.py blocks rm, pip install, chmod, chown entirely. rm even on files Ralph created himself. pip install blocked —Ralph cannot install a dev dependency for testing.

What to fix:
1. Allow rm within known safe directories (RALPH_DIR, /tmp, data/ subdirs) — block outside workspace
2. Allow pip install only with a safety flag: check if the command is in a known-allowed list OR add a --allow-pip flag
3. Allow chmod for setting executable bits on files Ralph created

Changes must preserve the security intent — do NOT open up general rm or pip install to the full allowlist.

Commit: git add tools.py && git commit -m fix: relax blocklist for rm in safe dirs, pip install, chmod
acceptanceCriteria: git -C ralph diff --cached tools.py | wc -l | grep -qE '[2-9]'

userStories.title: Integrate prd_linter.py into ralph.sh as a gate before Ralph runs
userStories.description:
Current state: prd_linter.py exists but is NEVER called by ralph.sh or ralph.py. Bad PRDs silently fail with confusing errors.

What to fix: Add a prd_linter check in ralph.sh before launching ralph.py. If lint errors are found, print them and exit with code 1 instead of running Ralph into the ground.

Commit: git add ralph.sh && git commit -m fix: gate ralph.sh with prd_linter validation

userStories.title: Add signal handler to ralph.py for graceful shutdown and lock release
userStories.description:
Current state: If ralph.py is killed mid-story, the lock file remains until the 2h stale threshold. SIGINT/SIGTERM received by the process do not clean up the lock.

What to fix: Add a signal handler that releases the lock file and exits cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Use Python's signal module to register handlers.

Commit: git add ralph.py && git commit -m fix: graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM releases lock
